verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents an App Marketplace with 350+ pre-built integrations and says users can import or sync contacts and activity data. That establishes its own integration capability, but the pack never names Stripe, Shopify, Segment or a database connector, and never says the integrations are first-party maintained. Custom-integration APIs and SDKs are developer building blocks and earn no credit. missing for 10: named Stripe/Shopify connectors, a Segment/CDP integration, a product-database sync connector, evidence the integrations are first-party maintained, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect the platform to my existing stack — Stripe or Shopify, a CDP like Segment, my product database — with maintained first-party integrations

citations.quote: Klaviyo App Marketplace: Cross-portfolio. 350+ pre-built integrations.
The free plan allows you to create a Klaviyo account, import or sync your contacts and activity data
